name: bluechew-automation
description: Playwright TypeScript automation framework for BlueChew

scripts.test:dev: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:prod: cross-env ENV_TYPE=prod npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:ci: cross-env ENV_TYPE=ci npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:demo: cross-env ENV_TYPE=demo npx playwright test src/specs
scripts.test:login: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test src/specs/login/login.spec.ts tests/visual/login.visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:login:update: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/login.visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:registration:visual: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/registration.visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:registration:update: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/registration.visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:quiz:visual: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/quiz.visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:quiz:visual:update: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/quiz.visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:results:visual: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/results.visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:results:visual:update: cross-env ENV_TYPE=dev npx playwright test tests/visual/results.visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
